mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_timeout_outbox (order_id, expires_at, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, expires_at, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at, sent_at FROM order_timeout_outbox WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
